article.title: Flamingo manufacturing units in Kyiv and Mykolaiv turned to ashes – Terror in Britain and the US: Russia
article.description: Flamingo manufacturing units in Kyiv and Mykolaiv turned to ashes – Terror in Britain and the US: Russia
paragraphs: In a new, aggressive surge of air operations, the Russian armed forces launched a barrage of attacks in recent hours with waves of drones and missiles, targeting the broader region of the capital, Kyiv, Odesa, critical energy and logistics hubs, manufacturing plants, and storage facilities for Flamingo missiles and drones. Additionally, targets included supply centers for weapons system manufacturing components, launch sites, and headquarters of Ukrainian forces and their allies. According to reports from local authorities and international analysts, the tactic of Russian forces has evolved into the continuous launching of unmanned aerial vehicles at regular intervals, aiming to sustain air threat alarms for many hours. This has resulted in...

the application of maximum pressure on Ukrainian air defense systems. At the same time, strikes on southern and eastern regions have caused severe problems for power infrastructure, leaving entire areas facing the prospect of widespread blackouts. The effectiveness of Russian maneuvers is also confirmed by Ukrainian sources, such as the outlet Insider.Ua, which referred to a strike model implemented by Russian forces in Kyiv, effectively blocking the city from the air. Indicatively, in just one day, the air threat alarm in the capital was activated 14 times, with its total duration exceeding 13 hours, causing complete paralysis in the functioning of state and military mechanisms. This new barrage of strikes came as a response to the massive Ukrainian drone attack that injured children in Rostov-on-Don and left a slaughter of casualties behind in Belgorod.

The Russian armed forces proceeded with a new series of coordinated attacks, targeting critical logistics centers and seaports used for the needs of Ukrainian troops. According to official information from the Ministry of Defense of Russia, group strikes were executed on the night of August 28 and during the night leading into August 29, hitting vital support installations. As clarified by the Russian defense ministry, the air and missile attacks were concentrated on the ports of Izmail and Mykolaiv. The result of the strikes was the destruction of parking areas for fuel transport tankers, unloading points for petroleum products and lubricants intended for Ukrainian forces, as well as a naval terminal and a central logistics hub.

The Russian armed forces dealt an exceptionally critical blow, dismantling infrastructure of vital importance for Ukraine's war industry. According to an official announcement by the Ministry of Defense of Russia on Telegram, a targeted attack was carried out on storage facilities housing components for Ukrainian "Flamingo" cruise missiles, as well as for FP-1 and FP-2 long-range remote-controlled drones. As clarified by the Russian defense ministry, the storage facility for "Flamingo" missile components was located in the Chayky area, while drone spare parts were stored in the settlement of Milaya. These specific storage sites belonged to the companies "Fim" and "Fire Point" respectively, located at key points in the broader Kyiv region. At the same time, Russian forces dealt a crucial blow to a distribution center through which military cargo was routed toward Ukrainian units. The severity of the attack is confirmed by the fact that Ukrainian firefighting forces were unable throughout the entire night to bring under control the extensive fire that broke out at facilities near the capital. Dense clouds of smoke covered the Kyiv region, with relevant videos circulating online showing the scale of destruction to Ukrainian military infrastructure.

Intense concern and discomfort were caused in the West by the furious stance of Russian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Maria Zakharova, who launched direct shots against the United Kingdom. Moscow's tough stance against London's dangerous tactics was recorded by the international agency Reuters, with RIA Novosti pointing out that Western powers now realize the severe consequences of their actions. Maria Zakharova's statements regarding the response Russia reserves for continuous weapons shipments from the United Kingdom were characterized by Reuters as unprecedentedly stern. The Russian Foreign Ministry spokesperson emphasized that London is now just one step away from being considered, in the eyes of Moscow, a legal accomplice in the conflict. This warning makes clear that Russia does not intend to tolerate further military involvement by Western countries. At the same time, the Russian Foreign Ministry signaled that there will be an immediate and decisive response in the event that an artificial escalation of the situation in the Transnistria region is attempted. Moscow makes it clear in every direction that it possesses the will and the means to defend its strategic interests and halt the provocative actions of the West.

article.title: Colonizers Attack Communities, Injure Palestinians Across West Bank
article.description: Illegal Israeli colonizers carried out attacks across the occupied West Bank. They injured Palestinians; assaulted farmers, residents, journalists, and inte ...
paragraphs: Illegal Israeli colonizers carried out attacks across the occupied West Bank. They injured Palestinians; assaulted farmers, residents, journalists, and international activists; attacked homes and agricultural lands; damaged property; obstructed medical access; and invaded religious sites.
In Arraba, south of Jenin in the northern West Bank, two Palestinians were injured in a colonizer assault on the residents’ lands.
Media sources said hundreds of colonizers broke into Awarta village, southeast of Nablus in the northern West Bank, and performed rituals at several Islamic shrines.
Israeli occupation forces closed the Deir Sharaf and Awarta military roadblocks surrounding Nablus as the colonizers entered the area.
In the Nablus governorate, in the northern West Bank, two Palestinians suffered bruises after colonizers, backed by Israeli occupation forces, attacked a home in the Ras Al-Ein area of Qusra village.

article.title: West Bank attacks: Two Palestinians shot, entry to village closed
paragraphs: Two Palestinians, including a 15-year-old child, were wounded by Israeli forces early Saturday morning during a raid on the al-Amari refugee camp in al-Bireh, Wafa reported.

The Palestinian Red Crescent Society reported that its crews treated two people wounded by live ammunition: a 15-year-old child who was shot in the back and a young man who sustained a gunshot wound to the leg.
Meanwhile, Israeli forces have closed the entrance to the village of Al-Mughayir, northeast of Ramallah, in the occupied West Bank, Quds News Network reported.

QNN also posted footage showing Israeli settlers grazing their sheep on Palestinian land in the Bedouin community of Khallet Al-Hummus area in the Masafer Yatta region, south of Hebron in the occupied West Bank.
Israeli occupation forces shut down the entrance to the village of Al-Mughayir, northeast of Ramallah, in the occupied West Bank. pic.twitter.com/eYqkmY961r

article.title: Israeli settlers, army continue attacks in West Bank towns
paragraphs: Israeli settler violence across occupied West Bank continued later on Saturday as settler groups launched new attacks on Palestinians in the villages of Burqa and Arrabeh, Palestine’s Wafa news agency reported.
In Burqa, Israeli settlers attacked local farmers, fired shots in their direction, and attempted to torch one of their vehicles.
In Arrabeh, settlers let their livestock graze on Palestinian-owned olive groves and attacked residents.
In a separate incident, Israeli forces opened fire and used tear gas after Palestinian residents confronted violent settlers in al-Mughayyir, northeast of Ramallah, according to Al Jazeera.
